defects.what: Preserved uncertainties about collection and shipment events (collection processes, dispatch/arrival events) are listed as uncertain, but the evidence provides no such uncertainty; all schedules and rates are verified.
defects.why_material: Removing these uncertainties would make the output deterministic (315 units), whereas including them could allow different outcomes, changing the simulation result.

reasoning: The world introduces preserved uncertainties about collection and shipment events (e.g., whether the drive operates as scheduled) that are not supported by the evidence.
